+from pathlib import Path

+
+s = Session("banana_in_bowl", instance="/app/instance.json")

+print("initial objects:", s.objects(), flush=True)
+print("initial ee:", s.ee_pose(), "closing dir:", p["get_finger_closing_dir"](), flush=True)
+
+obj = s.objects()["banana"]
+banana_pos = np.asarray(obj["position"], dtype=float)
+bowl_pos = np.asarray(s.objects()["bowl"]["position"], dtype=float)
+table_z = float(s.objects()["table"]["bounds"][1][2])
+quat = p["top_down_quat"](p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1.0, 0.0]))
+
+s.record_start()
+try:
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=12)
+    p["move_ee"]([banana_pos[0], banana_pos[1], 0.18], quat, speed=0.18, settle=3)
+    # The fingertip frame sits near the tabletop; the finger pads extend upward around the fruit.
+    p["move_ee"]([banana_pos[0], banana_pos[1], table_z + 0.012], quat, speed=0.08, settle=3)
+    p["close_gripper"](steps=24)
+    p["hold"](8)
+    print("after grasp:", s.objects()["banana"], "ee:", s.ee_pose(), "status:", s.status(), flush=True)
+
+    # Lift clear of the table and carry above the center of the bowl.
+    p["move_ee"]([banana_pos[0], banana_pos[1], 0.20], quat, speed=0.18, settle=3)

def with_depth(camera_cfg_cls):
    """Return a variant of ``camera_cfg_cls`` whose cameras also render depth.

    Builds a subclass with each contained camera's ``data_types`` extended by
    ``"depth"``, leaving the original class untouched so registrations without
    depth keep their rgb-only render cost. Camera attribute names (and thus
    prim paths and observation term names) are unchanged.
    """
    instance = camera_cfg_cls()
    overrides = {}
    for attr_name in dir(instance):
        if attr_name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        attr_value = getattr(instance, attr_name)
        if isinstance(attr_value, CameraCfg) and "depth" not in attr_value.data_types:
            camera = copy.deepcopy(attr_value)
            camera.data_types = [*camera.data_types, "depth"]
            overrides[attr_name] = camera
    if not overrides:
        return camera_cfg_cls
    variant = type(f"{camera_cfg_cls.__name__}WithDepth", (camera_cfg_cls,), overrides)
    return configclass(variant)
